'''Blue''' can refer to the following:

==[[Herb]]s==
* [[Blue goatflower]] - an herb that helps in the healing of bones.
* [[Bluespine tea]] - a tea from the [[Aiel Waste]] that [[Wise One]]s use on disagreeable people.
* [[Bluewort]] - an herb that can be brewed into a tea to help calm a queasy stomach.

==[[Ships]]==
* ''[[Blue Gull]]'' - an ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' ship.
* ''[[Blue Crane]]'' - a ship owned by [[Chin Ellisor]].
* ''[[Bluewing]]'' - a ship owned by [[Carney]].

==[[Inn]]s==
* [[The Blue Cat]] - an inn] in [[Tar Valon]].
* [[The Blue Rose]] - an inn in [[Canluum]].

==Others==
* [[Blue Ajah]] - [[Aes Sedai]] that dedicate themselves to causes.
* ''[[Winter's Heart/Chapter 33|Blue Carp Street]]'' - the thirty-third chapter of ''[[Winter's Heart]]''.
* [[Blue Reception Room]] - a small room in the [[Royal Palace of Andor]].
* [[Blue Sky Dawning]] - possibly a [[song]], used as a code word by [[Siuan Sanche]]
* [[Blue woman]] - a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that could possibly be used in long-range communication.
* ''era'' - a word in the [[Old Tongue]] that means "blue."
* [[Renaile din Calon Blue Star]] - a [[Windfinder]] of the ''Atha'an Miere''.
* ''[[Seiera]]'' - a word in the [[Old Tongue]] that means "blue eyes." It is also the name of a [[Seiera (horse)|horse]] and a [[Seiera (plant)|flower]].
